purpose: Design reading for a LIRF-inclusive network on the NM-clock residual target (nnlr = adsb_nn2's nnl + target_offset nm_clock) before the adsb_nn3 declaration. adsb_v30 showed that v25's LIRF network (nnl) cannot take more weight because on July's long-clock LIRF rows (labels 6,800-9,200 s) it predicts 900-2,800 s where the tree table and v9 predict 5,300-7,700 s; ten such rows carry 86% of its July matched-scope deficit. The residual target passes the NM clock through. nmres was dropped in adsb_nn2 on non-LIRF October readings only, where long clocks are rare; it was never read on LIRF.

protocol.data: tools/run_adsb_nn2.py --fold design: fit on the seasonal fold's fit partition (2025-02..06, 08, 09), LIRF ordinary rows included, fill population excluded; monitor on October; write the October predictions only.
protocol.never_read: No design run predicts, scores or reads a label of 2025-01, 2025-07, 2025-11, 2025-12 or the ranking months.
protocol.readings: tools/nn3_design_report.py on October 2025 rows of the two declared LIRF blend scopes (lirf_nonpop_matched, lirf_nonpop_unmatched; tools/run_adsb_v24 definitions) against the cross-fitted v9 (scratch/v24/2025-10): the RMSE of (1 - b) x v9 + b x network at the best b in 0.1..0.9 on the union of the two scopes (primary), per scope, and on long rows (v9 >= 7,200 s); for seed means of nnl (seeds 1-2 from adsb_nn2's design, 3-4 here) and nnlr (seeds 1-6), and the equal-compute mix nnl 1-2 + nnlr 1-2. The non-LIRF committee reading is descriptive.
protocol.decision: The adsb_nn3 development fits (16 nnlr seeds) go ahead only if the primary reading of the nnlr mean of 4 is below the nnl mean of 4's, or the mix nnl 1-2 + nnlr 1-2 is below the nnl mean of 4's. Otherwise the round stops with a recorded null.
